source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.8, printed pages 105-106.

blocks.text: Liquid ki khuli satah chhorne wale molecules us ke oopar hawa mein mil jate hain; khule bartan mein woh jate rehte hain. Band system mein nikle hue molecules satah ke oopar jama hote hain, bartan ki deewaron aur liquid ki satah se takrate hain, aur satah unhen dobara pakar sakti hai, jise condensation kehte hain. Evaporation aur condensation tab tak jari rehte hain jab tak evaporation ki raftar condensation ki raftar ke barabar na ho jaye.

blocks.title: Vapour pressure
blocks.text: Kisi darja hararat par apne liquid ke saath tawazun (equilibrium) mein liquid ke bukharat ka lagaya hua dabao vapour pressure kehlata hai.

Vapour pressure ki miqdar bartan mein liquid ki miqdar ya bartan ke hajm par munhasir nahi, na liquid ke surface area par: bara surface wapas aane wale molecules ke liye bara nishana hai, to condensation ki raftar evaporation ki raftar ke saath barhti hai. Khali kiye hue band bartan mein system liquid ke oopar khali jagah wali ibtidai halat se, darmiyani halat se guzar kar, tawazun ki halat tak jata hai jis mein evaporation aur condensation barabar hain (Figure 5.8).

blocks.alt: Teen band bartan, neeche liquid. (a) Shuru mein oopar khala (vacuum) hai aur molecules sirf liquid se nikalte hain (surkh teer oopar). (b) Baad mein bukhaarat jama ho gai aur kuch molecules lautte hain (hare teer neeche). (c) Equilibrium par jitne nikalte hain utne lautte hain: bukhaarat aur condensation ki raftar barabar.
blocks.caption: Khaali band bartan mein liquid ke bukhaarat se equilibrium tak pohanchna (Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Har jore mein kis liquid ka vapour pressure zyada hai: alcohol ya glycerine; petrol ya kerosene; mercury ya pani? Aur glycerine ya kerosene mein kaun zyada viscous hai?
blocks.explanation: Kamzor intermolecular forces wala liquid asani se evaporate hota hai aur us ka vapour pressure zyada hai: glycerine par alcohol (teen ke muqable ek O-H group), kerosene par petrol (chhote molecules, kamzor London forces), mercury par pani (metallic bonding mercury atoms ko kahin mazbooti se pakarti hai). Glycerine, apne teen hydrogen-bonding O-H groups ke saath, kerosene se kahin zyada viscous hai.

items: Band bartan mein evaporation aur condensation barabar raftar tak pohnchte hain; tab bukharat ka dabao vapour pressure hai, jo liquid aur darja hararat par munhasir hai magar liquid ki miqdar, bartan ke hajm ya surface area par nahi.
